summary.text: Seth Harp is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 3rd District. His Ballotpedia survey describes about 30 years in broadcast media as a host, anchor, reporter, director and operations manager, most recently at ESPN Gainesville, and FOX 35 describes him as a sixth-grade civics teacher. He is running on protecting Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid, term limits and child care relief.

paragraphs.text: Harp was born in Auburn, Indiana, graduated from DeKalb High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Western Michigan University in 2001.
After college he stayed in Kalamazoo, Michigan, and became, in his words, one of the youngest hosts in the history of WKZO radio.
He moved to Florida more than a decade ago to serve as Director of Programming and Host for iHeartMedia's Fox Sports Radio and Gator Radio affiliate in Jacksonville.
Harp has been Operations Manager for ESPN Gainesville (WRUF-AM) for about five years, as of his 2025 survey, and has taught as an adjunct at the University of Florida's College of Journalism.
FOX 35 describes him as a sixth-grade civics teacher and reports that he comes from a family of veterans, nurses and educators.
He won the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary over Tom Wells, Troy Albers and George Hubac.

His Ballotpedia profile lists his religion as United Methodist, and his survey describes a platform he calls the "13 Stripes of Strength", which includes a child care proposal he calls the C.U.B.S. Act.
